title: Lazy Sunday Yogurt Delight
description: A simple and delicious dessert to relax on a lazy Sunday afternoon. A sweet and tangy mix of yogurt, topped with fresh delight.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, mix together the plain yogurt and delight until well combined.
2. Add a teaspoon of Sunday if desired for added flavor.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
5. Garnish with fresh delight if desired.
